propositions: Structured replies with a single JSON object emit false 'multiple candidates validated' warnings because _candidate_dicts appends the same decoded dict twice: once from _all_json_objects() and once from json.loads()
_select_and_validate incorrectly identifies semantically identical Pydantic instances as ambiguous candidates by using identity (is not) rather than equality as the conflict test
Parser-generated duplicate candidates must be deduplicated by decoded dict value equality in discovery order before validation to eliminate false warnings
Genuinely distinct valid candidate objects must continue to select the last and emit the ambiguity warning as intended
The fix preserves caller contract: parse_structured returns validated result/exception; no caller depends on redundant validation or false warnings
